attempts.raw: {"risk": 5, "reason": "This drops net8.0/net9.0 support entirely (breaking any module/consumer not yet on .NET 10), pins to a .NET 10-rc Docker base image, removes IActionContextAccessor registration relied upon by third-party code while changing core URL-helper/ActionContext creation logic across many content parts (Link fields, Menu items, SEO), and swaps ForwardedHeaders KnownNetworks to KnownIPNetworks which can silently change reverse-proxy trust behavior in multi-tenant deployments."}
